edition: None found. District names come from the Emery County hosted Official Zone Map, 18-August-2023 revision (map legend only).
caveats: No zoning ordinance text was found for Castle Dale. The URL supplied (https://emery.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/CDzone.pdf) is only the official zone MAP (18-August-2023 revision): its legend lists RR-1 Rural Residential, R-1-8000 Residential, R-4-7500 Residential, R-1-MHP Mobile Home Park, HC-1 Highway Commercial, CC-1 Central Commercial, SC-1 Shopping Center, I-1 Light Industrial, PUD Planned Unit Development, plus flood plain overlays (Flood Plain Overlay, Flood Hazard, Primary Floodway).

Searched: emery.utah.gov (county zoning page links only maps), Zoneomics (castle-dale-UT code pages exist but contain no text), web search for a Castle Dale city code on any code host (none found). A Utah public notice shows the Castle Dale Planning Commission held land use hearings in March 2026, so the ordinance may have been revised. Ask Castle Dale City (20 South 100 East; zoning (435) 381-2115 per the county permit packet) for the current Land Use ordinance.
Do NOT substitute the neighbouring Ferron or Huntington codes: they are different ordinances even where district names match.
Every field except the district names is null/empty because nothing was verified.
